title: Large language models for abstract screening in systematic- and scoping reviews: A diagnostic test accuracy study

prompt.location: Supplementary materials (full LLM prompts); Table 1 (PICOs criteria used in the prompt)
prompt.note: Prompt text not in the main text.

data.source: 500 abstracts sampled from PubMed searches (search strings in supplement); two-reader reference standard; abstract list/labels release not stated

notes: Temperature 0.2 and 0.8 runs; gpt-4o-2024-05-13 also evaluated (97%).

resolution.plan: The full PICOs inclusion/exclusion prompt (prompt 1), the PubMed search strings and the per-abstract numbers are in the medRxiv supplementary materials, not in the main text. With the supplement, re-run gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0.2 (two runs) on the 492 abstracts and compute accuracy against Table 2 (482/492). If the supplement does not list the abstract DOIs and the two-reader decisions, the sample can only be approximated from the search string and the labels cannot be rebuilt (then data_closed).
resolution.approximation: JSON-output parsing; the 500-abstract random sample and reader labels are reproducible only if listed in the supplement.
